title: fix(app-shell): a menu reordered in design mode is saved in the order the sidebar draws it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #36591
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在运行界面的设计模式里调整菜单顺序（上移、下移、移到分组、在前后加一项、添加菜单项、拖动）并保存后，侧栏现在按设计模式里显示的顺序排列；以前在 AI 搭建、菜单项带排序号的应用里，保存成功却毫无变化，再进设计模式看到的顺序也和侧栏相反。
- 属于「运行界面的设计模式」专题，替用 AI 搭建应用、要在应用里直接调菜单的管理员解决「改了不生效、也不报错」的问题。
- 出错时，带排序号的应用保存菜单后侧栏顺序会和设计模式不一致；只影响菜单顺序，不丢菜单项，可以在设计模式里再调一次保存，或撤回本次合并恢复旧行为。
- 无。

## What changes

The sidebar sorts each level of an app's `navigation` by `order` (`byNavOrder` in `@object-ui/layout`: lower first, an absent `order` as 0, ties in array order). Design mode listed and saved the array as authored, so in an app whose entries carry `order` a move was saved and published and changed nothing on screen.

Route taken (the claim's Route, the card's first option): **rewrite `order` on save, never drop it.**

- **Display** — design mode seeds its menu with every level put in the sidebar's order (`inShownOrder` in `designModeMenuModel.ts`, which sorts each level through `inMenuOrder`, the app-shell statement of the sidebar's rule; no new comparator). The menu reads the same in and out of the mode.
- **Save** — `saveAppMenu` puts the stored menu in that same shown order before the edits are replayed on it (`rebaseMenuEdits`), then rewrites `order` on the result (`withOrderRewritten`): each level in which **any** entry carries `order` has **every** entry numbered `0, 1, …` in the order design mode showed; group entries and each group's children are numbered per level. A level where no entry carries `order` is saved by array order and gains no key (HotCRM-shaped apps are unchanged).
- **Why `0..n-1`**: it is the smallest rule that makes `byNavOrder` draw exactly the array order (no ties are possible inside a renumbered level), it covers the mixed level the card names, and it is idempotent: a second save of the same menu writes the same numbers. Dropping `order` was rejected because it deletes authored keys from AI-built apps.
- **Why the stored menu is sorted first**: the edits are replayed by place ("after the entry before it"), and the stored array of an `order`-carrying app is not in shown order. Without the sort an entry added at the end of `[X(2), Y(1), Z(0)]` lands after `X` in the array and is numbered between `X` and `Y`. A stored entry the reader was never shown (pruned) keeps its shown place among the rest.
- `rebaseMenuEdits` and `order`: the editor never writes `order`, so the served and edited copies of an entry always agree on it and it is never a patch key; the stored value travels with the entry and is then rewritten. Nothing is treated as a conflict and nothing is dropped. Pinned by "a move up is written as `order`; a rename beside it writes its label, and `order` is never read as an edit".

### Why #36363's tests did not catch it

Every fixture in the three #36363 test files authored its menu **without `order`** (HotCRM-shaped), where array order is the sidebar order. The save pins read the written navigation's **array positions** (`navigation[1].children.map((c) => c.id)`), and nothing drew the saved menu through the sidebar's renderer. Its acceptance line "上移并保存：顺序变了；刷新后还在" was therefore true of every fixture and false of the AI-built app the coordinator saved. The new pins draw what the save wrote through the real `NavigationRenderer` and compare it with what design mode showed, over menus that carry `order`.

## Tests

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` — the two lines around `rebaseMenuEdits`: the sort before the replay and the rewrite after the payload.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts` — `inShownOrder` and `withOrderRewritten`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx` — the `served` seed.

New pins, each a top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness of its subject (no new test files):

- `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx` · "the design-mode menu in the sidebar order (objectstack#36591)" — real `DesignModeMenu` + mode save, the sidebar read from a rendered `NavigationRenderer` (no sort written in the test): ordered app reads the same in design mode and in the sidebar; Move up on Contacts then Save → sidebar reads Contacts, Customers, …, and the saved app re-opens design mode in that order; Add an item after + Move to group → the sidebar places both where design mode showed them; CONTROL: an app with no `order` saves a move by array order and gains no `order` key; a mixed level reads as design mode after one save.
- `designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts` · "the save writes the order the editor showed as `order` (objectstack#36591)" — added at the end, move up with a rename beside it, a pruned entry, and the no-`order` control.
- `designModeMenuModel-36363.test.ts` · "a level in the sidebar order, and that order written back as `order` (objectstack#36591)".

<details><summary>Runs (head f4425f440e)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/layout/` → `Test Files 155 passed (155)`, `Tests 1247 passed (1247)`; lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The three touched files alone → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 75 passed (75)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`) → lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, after rebuilding the dependency closure the `origin/main` merge moved (a first run against the pre-merge `dist` reported `RecordDetailView.tsx` TS2322 from main's merged change; gone after the rebuild).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation — the order rewrite removed</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts --anchor 'const nextNav = withOrderRewritten(navPayloadOf(rebased as unknown[]) as Menu);' --replacement 'const nextNav = navPayloadOf(rebased as unknown[]) as Menu; void withOrderRewritten;'` over the three files:

- `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob b319aa8229c4 -> fd40d9929ee0`
- `Test Files 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`, `Tests 6 failed | 69 passed (75)` — red: the three `order` save pins, and in the render harness Move up, Add after + Move to group, and the mixed level. The two CONTROL pins (no `order`) and the display pin stay green, as they should.
- `ok restored: blob == HEAD (b319aa8229c4) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Renumbering rewrites authored values.** Saving a menu whose level carries `order` writes consecutive numbers on every entry of that level (an authored `10, 20, 30` becomes `0, 1, 2`), even when the save only renamed an entry. The order drawn is unchanged; the values are not preserved.
- **Another package's entries (`navigationContributions`) keep their own `order`.** They are not in the stored menu, so they are not renumbered. One that carries no `order` keeps its place (it sorts as 0 right after the app's first entry, as design mode now shows it); one that carries its own `order` can sit in a different place relative to the renumbered entries than design mode showed. No live app was found with such a contribution; noted, not filed.
- **Two save rules for one key.** Studio's nav canvas (`AppNavCanvas` `moveItem`) writes `order` on the moved entry only; design mode now renumbers the level. Both draw the order their editor showed; they differ in how many keys a save writes. Observation only.
- **Browser check: NOT MEASURED**, reason: the worktree has no built runtime or Console (`packages/console/dist` absent), and a full build plus a seeded backend on this shared 4-core box was not taken on for this card; the sidebar half is measured instead by rendering the real `NavigationRenderer` over the written navigation.
- **Overlap**: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exits 1 against #36606 (shares `DesignModeMenu.tsx`, `designModeMenuSave.ts`, conflicts in `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`); the seat sequenced this card first and #36606 rebases on it.

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx -t "sidebar order"` — expect 5 passed, among them "「Move up」 on Contacts, saved: the sidebar reads Contacts, Customers, …".

Local gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 commands for this diff; all 38 ran with exit 0 and `--ran` reconciles "38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The `ui/scripts` vitest family was run with `--maxWorkers=2` added (dispatch order). Families CI runs are read from this PR's check-runs.
